name: Recruitee
summary: Recruitee publishes no prices for its Start, Advance and Optimize plans, which cost more with company size and carry a one-year minimum commitment. Paying annually earns a 20% discount, and a free trial link is offered without card details.

facts.text: Published jobs are sent automatically to Indeed and Google for Jobs by default, and other boards can be added from the Promote tab, including in bulk.
Pipelines have three stage groups: Applicants, Active process and Hires.
Its collaborative hiring page describes scheduling interviews into team agendas and structured feedback from hiring managers through a scorecard or note.

hiddenCosts: Subscriptions are tiered by plan, number of employees and billing period.
Contracts have a minimum commitment of one year even when billed monthly.

contract.cancellation: The pricing FAQ states a minimum commitment of one year, with monthly payment possible. Paying annually gives a 20% discount.
